# Confirm the correct column names
print('Column names:', trial_df.columns.tolist())

print('\nResponse rate by sex:')

# Check if the groups are balanced
print('\nSex group sizes:')
print(trial_df['sex'].value_counts())

# Check if severity is balanced across sex
print('\nSeverity by sex:')
print(pd.crosstab(trial_df['sex'], trial_df['severity']))

# Check if treatment arm is balanced across sex
print('\nTreatment arm by sex:')
print(pd.crosstab(trial_df['sex'], trial_df['arm']))

# Check if biomarker baseline is balanced across sex
print('\nBiomarker baseline by sex (mean):')
print(trial_df.groupby('sex')['biomarker_baseline'].mean())
